title: Slide Fourteen
mood: sheepish, grateful and smiling at himself
subject: running the lyric slides at a Sunday service and always being one line behind the band
caption: Christian worship-pop in the bouncy 2025 CCM-crossover style. A bright strummed steel-string acoustic guitar with a ukulele doubling the chords; a lo-fi hip-hop drum loop with a swung kick, a soft snare dusted with vinyl crackle and finger snaps on two and four; a clean Rhodes electric piano holding warm seventh chords; a round electric bass playing short notes; a unison congregation gang vocal arriving on the last chorus. Close and warm, narrow low end, the acoustic guitar and lead voice forward, a light room sound on the gang vocal. Male voice, an earnest, clear light baritone, half-rapping the verses in a relaxed conversational flow and singing the chorus straight. 100 BPM, G major. Sheepish, grateful and smiling at himself. No gospel choir or Hammond organ, no soul melisma, no ambient worship pads or dotted-eighth delay guitar, no slow stadium build, no trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no EDM drop.
lyrics:
[Intro - strummed acoustic guitar and finger snaps]

[Verse 1]
Nine-fifteen on Sunday, I'm up in the booth with the laptop
Pastor Dave gave me the clicker when Kyle moved to Phoenix
Band's already on the second verse and I'm still on the title
Three hundred people looking up at a blank blue screen

[Pre-Chorus]
I hit the arrow twice, now it's last week's song
Mrs Alvarez sings it right without me

[Chorus]
I'm a line behind, I'm a line behind
Every Sunday morning I'm a line behind
And they sing it anyway, they don't even look up
Slide fourteen, I'm still catching up

[Verse 2]
Week four, somebody typed the bridge and spelled Lord as Lard
A kid in row three laughs till his mom gives him the look
I'm sweating in the booth with my finger on backspace
And the room just sings right over the typo

[Pre-Chorus]
Then the bulb in the projector pops
And nobody needs me at all

[Chorus - gang vocals enter]
I'm a line behind, I'm a line behind
Every Sunday morning I'm a line behind
And they sing it in the dark, every single word
Slide fourteen, and I'm singing too

[Bridge - Rhodes and finger snaps only]
Lights come up on the last amen
And I'm standing in the booth with both hands up

[Outro - acoustic guitar alone]
Pastor Dave says keep the clicker
I say only if the bulb blows again
